name: Century egg
description: Duck eggs cured in alkaline clay for months until the white turns to dark jelly.

tcm.note: Read with duck egg; the alkaline cure is cooling and descending.

ayurveda.note: Ushna as an egg; the preservation has no classical parallel.

histamine.note: Months of alkaline curing on an egg base — both the egg's liberator flag and a heavy preserved-protein load.
